# FreshFromChina: Guangdong's Underwater Data Centers

**Traced to: [33] Reuters, [36] cnbayarea.org.cn (actual plan), [37] 每经网**

Blog post (Jan 30, 2026) summarizing the Guangdong Province Action Plan for Promoting High-Quality Development of the Marine Economy (2025-2027). Not an independent source.

## Key Claims (all traceable to primary sources)
- Guangdong released "Guangdong Province Action Plan for Promoting High-Quality Development of the Marine Economy (2025-2027)" — **traced to [36] cnbayarea.org.cn** and **[37] 每经网**.
- Plan aims to accelerate marine electronic information industry: "sensing, transmission, storage, calculation, and application."
- Underwater data centers leverage seawater for natural cooling, reducing energy (traditional DCs spend **30-40% of energy on cooling**).
- Similar marine initiatives in Guangdong historically saw investments of **¥10-20 billion RMB (~$1.41-2.82B USD)**.
- Released by General Office of Guangdong Provincial CPC Committee + General Office of Guangdong Provincial Government.

## Assessment
- `authoritative: no` — FreshFromChina is a blog/aggregator.
- All load-bearing facts trace to the official plan document ([36]) and 每经网 ([37]).
